title: Add leads: quick add, paste a list, table view
next: Call a lead and log what happened

say: Three quick ways to get your leads into Sales X-Ray.
Sales X-Ray में leads डालने के तीन आसान तरीके.
caption: Sales X-Ray mein leads daalne ke teen aasaan tareeke.

say: Sales X-Ray मध्ये leads टाकायचे तीन सोपे मार्ग.
caption: Sales X-Ray madhye leads takayche teen sope marg.

say: On a computer, open Leads and switch to Table.
Every lead on one line: stage, owner, source and the next action.
Computer पे Leads खोलिए और Table पे switch कीजिए.
हर lead एक line में: stage, owner, source और next action.
caption: Computer pe Leads kholiye aur Table pe switch kijiye.
Har lead ek line mein: stage, owner, source aur next action.

say: Computer वर Leads उघडा आणि Table वर switch करा.
प्रत्येक lead एका line मध्ये: stage, owner, source आणि next action.
caption: Computer var Leads ughda aani Table var switch kara.
Pratyek lead eka line madhye: stage, owner, source aani next action.

say: To add one lead, type a name and a number in the last line, and press Enter.
The lead rules pick the owner for you.
एक lead add करना है? आख़िरी line में नाम और number डालिए, और Enter दबाइए.
Owner lead rules अपने आप चुन लेते हैं.
caption: Ek lead add karna hai? Aakhri line mein naam aur number daaliye, aur Enter dabaiye.
Owner lead rules apne aap chun lete hain.

say: एक lead add करायचाय? शेवटच्या line मध्ये नाव आणि number टाका, आणि Enter दाबा.
Owner lead rules आपोआप निवडतात.
caption: Ek lead add karaychay? Shevatchya line madhye naav aani number taka, aani Enter daba.
Owner lead rules aapoaap nivadtat.

target.placeholder: Or paste rows from a sheet, a CSV or ChatGPT

say: Got a list in Google Sheets, Excel, a CSV, or from ChatGPT?
Copy the rows and paste them right here. Sales X-Ray matches the columns, and adds them all in one go.
Google Sheets, Excel, CSV या ChatGPT में list है?
Rows copy कीजिए और यहीं paste कर दीजिए. Sales X-Ray columns खुद match करता है, और सब एक साथ add कर देता है.
caption: Google Sheets, Excel, CSV ya ChatGPT mein list hai?
Rows copy kijiye aur yahin paste kar dijiye. Sales X-Ray columns khud match karta hai, aur sab ek saath add kar deta hai.

say: Google Sheets, Excel, CSV किंवा ChatGPT मध्ये list आहे?
Rows copy करा आणि इथेच paste करा. Sales X-Ray columns स्वतः match करतो, आणि सगळ्या एकदम add करतो.
caption: Google Sheets, Excel, CSV kinva ChatGPT madhye list aahe?
Rows copy kara aani ithech paste kara. Sales X-Ray columns swatah match karto, aani saglya ekdam add karto.

say: On the phone, the quick add bar sits right above your list.
Phone पे quick add bar आपकी list के ठीक ऊपर है.
caption: Phone pe quick add bar aapki list ke theek upar hai.

say: Phone वर quick add bar तुमच्या list च्या अगदी वर आहे.
caption: Phone var quick add bar tumchya list chya agdi var aahe.

say: Or tap plus, then Add lead, from any screen. A name and a number is enough.
या किसी भी screen से plus दबाइए, फिर Add lead. नाम और number काफ़ी है.
caption: Ya kisi bhi screen se plus dabaiye, phir Add lead. Naam aur number kaafi hai.

say: किंवा कुठल्याही screen वरून plus दाबा, मग Add lead. नाव आणि number पुरेसा आहे.
caption: Kinva kuthlyahi screen varun plus daba, mag Add lead. Naav aani number puresa aahe.
